The '''Gaddria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Oricho sector/Legends|Oricho sector]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the [[Gaddrian ambassador]],<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Gaddrian ambassador]]|system=Gaddria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the leader of a faction within the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] that was sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="The Lap of Luxury">{{WEGCite|story=The Lap of Luxury|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gaddria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-5.<ref name="TEA" />
